mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_view_history (user_id, post_id, viewed_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{postId}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE viewed_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.title, p.summary, p.cover_image, p.thumbnail, p.view_count, p.like_count, p.favorite_count, p.series_id, p.series_sort, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments cm WHERE cm.post_id = p.id AND cm.deleted_at IS NULL) as comment_count, p.status, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.deleted_at, vh.viewed_at, -- 分类信息 c.id as cat_id, c.name as cat_name, -- 系列信息 s.name as series_name, -- 作者信息 u.id as author_user_id, u.username as author_username, u.avatar_url as author_avatar_url, -- 用户状态（浏览历史中的文章视为未点赞未收藏） CASE WHEN pl.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as like_status, 0 as favorite_status FROM user_view_history vh INNER JOIN posts p ON p.id = vh.post_id LEFT JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN post_series s ON p.series_id = s.id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN users u ON p.author_id = u.id LEFT JOIN post_likes pl ON p.id = pl.post_id AND pl.user_id = #{userId} AND pl.is_like = 1 AND pl.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE vh.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 'published' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY vh.viewed_at DESC
